_comment: Direct-trust leg (see docs/architecture.md) - no CIMD document, no ID-JAG. Authority/ClientId/ClientSecret are for whatever hosted AS you register a client at - this repo's local Keycloak by default (mcpinterop-partner-direct, see deploy/keycloak/import/mcpinterop-realm.json), or a real hosted AS like Auth0 (create an API whose identifier is TargetServerEndpoint, plus a Regular Web App for this project's redirect-based login). Send Authority to the partner so they can allowlist it. ClientSecret below is the local Keycloak client's throwaway secret (already public in mcpinterop-realm.json, same as Client's Ema:ResourceClientSecret) - for a real hosted AS, use 'dotnet user-secrets set "Partner:ClientSecret" "..." --project src/OpenID.MCPInterop.Client.Partner' instead.
